evidence_scatter.title: Preoperative assessment of peritoneal carcinomatosis with [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: FAPI PET had ICC 0.81, MRI 0.76, and FDG PET 0.54. In the recent chemotherapy subgroup, ICCs were 0.75, 0.65, and 0.46, respectively.

evidence_scatter.title: A 3-year landmark overall survival analysis of RP1 plus nivolumab in patients with anti–PD-1–failed melanoma from the IGNYTE clinical trial.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: The 3-year overall survival rate was 45.5% (95% CI: 35.8%-54.7%) in the overall population.

evidence_scatter.title: Amivantamab in HPV-unrelated recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell cancer after disease progression on immune checkpoint inhibitor and chemotherapy: Pivotal results from the phase 1b/2 OrigAMI-4 study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Confirmed ORR 47% (48/102; 95% CI 37-57) with 4 CR and 44 PR; 79% experienced target lesion shrinkage.

evidence_scatter.title: Real-world risk of interstitial lung disease and pneumonitis with trastuzumab deruxtecan vs trastuzumab in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer: A propensity score–matched analysis.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Incidence elevated in T-DXd group (11.1%) vs trastuzumab (6.8%). Risk difference: 4.3% (95% CI: 2.4-6.1).

evidence_scatter.title: RAPID: A pilot feasibility study of rapid dinutuximab infusion in patients with relapsed/refractory (RR) high-risk neuroblastoma (HRNBL).
Erythrocyte–anti–PD-1 conjugates in patients with advanced solid tumors resistant to anti–PD-1/PD-L1 therapy: Long-term follow-up of a phase I trial.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: ORR was 42.9% (6/14; 1 CR, 1 uCR, 4 PR), with improved responses observed in the higher-dose cohort.

evidence_scatter.title: Post-treatment recovery patterns among patients with early-stage cancer who develop taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy (TIPN): SWOG S1714 (NCT03939481).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Clinically meaningful TIPN at 3 years vs baseline in 51.2%.

evidence_scatter.title: Health-related quality of life (HRQOL) in the phase 3 trial of standard chemotherapy alone or combined with atezolizumab as adjuvant therapy for patients with stage III deficient DNA mismatch repair (dMMR) colon cancer (Alliance A021502, ATOMIC).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Non-inferiority of atezo+mFOLFOX6 met at 6 mo; no significant between-arm differences at any timepoint.

evidence_scatter.title: Toripalimab plus chemotherapy and radiotherapy for treatment-naïve advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: Long-term survival and recurrence patterns.
Sequencing in the post-immunotherapy era: Does second-line tyrosine kinase inhibitor choice impact survival and safety in advanced HCC?
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: 1-year overall survival was 47.1% with lenvatinib versus 31.9% with cabozantinib (HR 0.65, 95% CI 0.45-0.95; p=0.026).

evidence_scatter.title: Interim analysis of TAD: A phase 2 single-arm open-label study of combination therapy of transarterial chemoembolization and ablation with durvalumab in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Median PFS 12.5 months (95% CI: 9.4-15.6), events in 15 patients.

evidence_scatter.title: First-in-human study to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and PK of EIK1005, a novel WRN inhibitor in healthy participants.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: EIK1005 was well tolerated; adverse events were unrelated and predominantly mild.

evidence_scatter.title: Spatial transcriptomic profiling of the tumor microenvironment associated with sunitinib response in metastatic renal cell carcinoma.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: The median time to progression was 8.2 months (95% CI: 6.1-19.3).

evidence_scatter.title: iPREDICT: Phase II study of CD8 PET in patients with immunoresponsive solid tumors—Imaging characteristics and correlation with RECIST response.
Avatrombopag for chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia in gastrointestinal malignancies (ACT-GI): A multicenter, U.S., randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Trial closed to enrollment for overwhelming efficacy at interim analysis; 16/23 (70%; 95% CI 47-87) in AVA versus 4/24 (17%; 95% CI 5-37) in placebo achieved the primary endpoint (Z=3.67, P<0.001).

evidence_scatter.title: A randomized phase II trial of folate receptor alpha peptide vaccine in early-stage triple-negative breast cancer.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: 3.5-year DFS rate was 88% (FRPV) and 90% (placebo).

evidence_scatter.title: Prognostic factors and impact of concomitant medication in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) treated with first-line chemotherapy plus anti-PD-L1: A Spanish multicenter real-world study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: With median follow-up of 27.2 months, median OS was 10.2 months (95% CI 8.4-11.3).

evidence_scatter.title: RATIONALE-315: Post hoc analysis of event-free survival by surgically relevant subgroups treated with perioperative tislelizumab and neoadjuvant chemotherapy vs neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: EFS benefit with tislelizumab vs placebo (HR: 0.62; 95% CI: 0.44-0.88). R0 resection patients (HR: 0.62; 95% CI: 0.43-0.90). R1/R2 patients (HR: 0.75; 95% CI: 0.19-3.05).

evidence_scatter.title: Phase 1 study results with PRAME-directed T-cell receptor (TCR) T-cell therapies in synovial sarcoma.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: The confirmed objective response rate was 50% (10/20), including 1 confirmed complete response (8%) with IMA203CD8 at a dose of 2.05 x 10^9 total TCR T cells.

evidence_scatter.title: Cigarette smoking on outcomes with osimertinib in EGFR-mutated non–small cell lung cancer: A real-world analysis.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: No difference in primary matched analysis (32% vs 32%; p=0.824); inferior for smokers in sensitivity analysis excluding smoking-related comorbidities (32% vs 34%; p=0.046).

evidence_scatter.title: Immune-related thyroid dysfunction and overall survival in metastatic colorectal cancer treated with pembrolizumab: A real-world TriNetX analysis.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Patients who developed thyroid dysfunction had significantly improved OS: median OS 780 vs 513 days; log-rank p = 0.017; HR 0.71; 95% CI 0.54–0.94.

evidence_scatter.title: A retrospective analysis of cardiovascular outcomes in patients with prostate cancer treated with upfront gonadotropin-releasing agonist versus antagonists utilizing real-world data.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: MACE occurred in 2,554 (22.56%) of patients in the GnRH agonist arm versus 1,618 (15.02%) of patients in the GnRH antagonist arm (HR 1.649, 95% CI 1.539-1.766, p < 0.0001).

evidence_scatter.title: Safety and preliminary efficacy of M9466 (HRS-1167) in combination with abiraterone acetate and prednisone/prednisolone (AA-P) in patients (pts) with metastatic prostate cancer in the phase 1 DDRiver 501 study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Across patients with baseline RECIST measurable disease, confirmed ORR was 18.8% (3/16, 95% CI: 4.0, 45.6).

evidence_scatter.title: Penpulimab (AK105) combined with cetuximab as first-line treatment in recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (R/M HNSCC): A phase II clinical trial.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: The objective response rate was 44.8% (13/29) among 29 evaluable patients.

evidence_scatter.title: A phase 2 trial of cetuximab for patients with locally advanced/metastatic chordoma.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: 2 of 25 efficacy-evaluable patients achieved a partial response.

evidence_scatter.title: LAP-NET1: Results of a phase 1b evaluating NP137, an inhibitor of the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, in combination with mFOLFIRINOX for the first-line treatment of locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Objective response rate was 29%

evidence_scatter.title: Comparative effectiveness and toxicity of CAR-T therapy versus blinatumomab in adult B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia: A real-world propensity-matched analysis.

evidence_scatter.title: Safety and feasibility of cabozantinib (CABO) in combination with cisplatin, doxorubicin, and high-dose methotrexate (MAP) in patients with newly diagnosed high-risk osteosarcoma (OS).
Hepatic artery infusion chemotherapy plus adebrelimab and bevacizumab as first-line treatment for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus.

evidence_scatter.title: Safety of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in patients receiving chimeric antigen receptor T cell or bispecific T cell engager therapy.

evidence_scatter.title: Phase 2 study of intratumoral oncolytic VV1 plus cemiplimab: Simon's stage 1 results from head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) cohort.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: ORR 30% (3 confirmed PRs); 8/10 patients had reduction in target lesion sum (mean -16%, range -57% to +77%); median duration of response not reached (2/3 responders progressed at 6.2 and 9.9 mo; 1 PR ongoing at 7.7 mo)

evidence_scatter.title: FID-007 in combination with cetuximab in recurrent or metastatic (R/M) head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC).

evidence_scatter.title: Initial safety and efficacy of A2B694, a logic-gated mesothelin (MSLN)–targeted Tmod chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR T) therapy in patients with advanced solid tumors with HLA-A*02 loss of heterozygosity (LOH).

evidence_scatter.title: Comparative survival and long-term gastrointestinal outcomes of ipilimumab/nivolumab vs durvalumab/tremelimumab in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

evidence_scatter.title: Neoadjuvant hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy (HAIC) plus tislelizumab (Tisle) combined with adjuvant tisle as a perioperative therapy for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) at high-risk of recurrence: A single-arm, phase II study.

evidence_scatter.title: Impact of immunotherapy on sotorasib toxicity in NSCLC: A real-world matched analysis.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: In matched cohorts, prior ICI exposure significantly increased rates of Grade ≥3 hepatotoxicity compared to ICI-naïve patients: 13.2% vs 4.4%; RR 3.0 (95% CI: 1.76-5.1); p<0.001.

evidence_scatter.title: A prospective phase II clinical study of different time-delivered drugs combined with intensity-modulated radiotherapy for locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

evidence_scatter.title: ISABELA: A phase 2 study of isatuximab, belantamab mafodotin, pomalidomide, and dexamethasone in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

evidence_scatter.title: Cardiovascular outcomes after bispecific T-cell-engager therapy in multiple myeloma: A propensity-matched real-world study.

evidence_scatter.title: Effectiveness outcomes by treatment-free interval among patients receiving palbociclib plus endocrine therapy in HR+/HER2− advanced breast cancer in the real-world setting: Results from the PERFORM study.

Tremelimumab (T) + durvalumab (D) + chemotherapy (CT) vs pembrolizumab (P) + CT in 1L non-squamous (NSQ) metastatic NSCLC (mNSCLC) with STK11, KEAP1, and/or KRAS mutations (mut): Interim analysis (IA) of the phase 2b TRITON study.

evidence_scatter.title: Pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of the GCN2 activator HC-7366 in a phase 1a study in patients with advanced solid tumors.

evidence_scatter.title: First-in-human study of ALK201, a FGFR2b-targeting antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) for patients (pts) with advanced solid tumors.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: ORR was 24% (95% CI: 9.4-45.1) among 25 evaluable patients; in the >=7.2 mg/kg subgroup, ORR was 35.7% (5/14).

evidence_scatter.title: Concomitant radiotherapy, tremelimumab, and durvalumab for advanced NSCLC patients progressing on first-line immunotherapy: A phase 2 study (CORAL-Lung).

evidence_scatter.title: BI‑1808 + pembrolizumab: Responses to a chemotherapy‑free regimen in advanced ovarian cancer.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Among 17 response-evaluable patients, 4 achieved confirmed partial response (ORR 24%).

evidence_scatter.title: Real-world outcomes among Medicare beneficiaries treated with first-line (1L) Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors (BTKis) for chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL).
A phase 1 study of BGB-A3055 (anti-CCR8) with or without tislelizumab (anti–PD-1) in patients with solid tumors.

evidence_scatter.title: Localized (Z)-n-butylidenephthalide biodegradable wafer as surgical adjuvant in recurrent glioblastoma for extending survival and re-sensitizing chemotherapy: A compassionate use study.

evidence_scatter.title: A phase II study of pemetrexed and pembrolizumab in patients (pts) with recurrent and/or metastatic (R/M) salivary gland cancer (SGC): Results from the adenoid cystic cohort.

evidence_scatter.title: First-line (1L) olomorasib + pembrolizumab in patients with KRAS G12C–mutant advanced NSCLC, and PD-L1 expression 0-49%, from the dose optimization cohorts of LOXO-RAS-20001 and SUNRAY-01.
A phase II trial of fruquintinib combined with cadonilimab in refractory MSS/pMMR colorectal cancer with pulmonary metastases.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: The ORR was 31.4%.

evidence_scatter.title: T320 tissue factor-targeted ADC from pre-clinical research to phase I clinical study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: One patient with ovarian cancer in the 0.4 mg/kg Q3W cohort achieved durable stable disease for 6 months.

evidence_scatter.title: Optimization of immunotherapy duration for advanced melanoma: The prospective OTIMAS trial.

PFS benefit was observed regardless of prior anti-angiogenic exposure, with significant benefit in the subgroup previously treated with anti-angiogenic agents.

evidence_scatter.title: Transarterial embolization plus hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy combined with rivoceranib and camrelizumab for initially unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma with high tumor burden: A single-arm, prospective, multicenter study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: According to RECIST1.1 criteria, the objective response rate was 64.7%.

evidence_scatter.title: Objective response rates with Ori-C101, an armored GPC3-directed CAR-T, in heavily pretreated advanced HCC: Updated results from the phase Ib BEACON study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Confirmed ORR was 50.0% (9/18).

evidence_scatter.title: Additional health-related quality of life (HRQoL) analysis from DESTINY-Gastric04 (DG-04), a randomized phase 3 study of trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) vs ramucirumab (RAM) + paclitaxel (PTX) in patients (pts) with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2–positive (HER2+) unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer (GC)/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA).

evidence_scatter.title: A phase Ib study of osimertinib and tegavivint as first-line therapy in patients with metastatic EGFR-mutated non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: The ORR was 73%, with 2 of 15 patients (13%) achieving a complete response.

evidence_scatter.title: Alrizomadlin (APG-115) alone or in combination with lisaftoclax (APG-2575) for the treatment of pediatric patients with relapsed/metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) or other soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: ORR (CR + PR) was 30% among 10 evaluable combination-arm patients.

evidence_scatter.title: Pyrotinib versus pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and taxane as first-line therapy for HER2-positive advanced breast cancer: A retrospective cohort study using propensity score overlap weighting.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Median PFS was 17.0 months with THP vs 25.0 months with PyHT; HR 0.82 (95% CI 0.55–1.24); p=0.55.

evidence_scatter.title: Efficacy of nimotuzumab combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy for patients with postoperative loco‑regional recurrent esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A phase II study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: ORR was 85.71%; 12 (28.57%) patients achieved complete response and 24 (57.14%) patients achieved partial response.

evidence_scatter.title: Overall survival after intravenous iron use in patients with cancer and iron deficiency: A propensity-matched real-world study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Median OS was 875 days in IV iron group vs 858 days in no IV iron group (log-rank p=0.53).

evidence_scatter.title: Elacestrant in combination with capivasertib in patients with ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer: Update from ELEVATE, a phase 1b/2, open-label, umbrella study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: In RP2D response-evaluable pts (n=9), mPFS was 11.3 mo.

evidence_scatter.title: A phase II study of trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) combined with ribociclib in patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (RibHER).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Overall ORR was 41.7%. In subgroup analyses, ORR was 28.6% in the ER-positive subgroup versus 60.0% in the ER-negative subgroup.

evidence_scatter.title: Impact of COVID-19 mRNA vaccines on survival outcomes in patients with solid tumors receiving immunotherapy: A large-scale retrospective study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Vaccination within 100 days of ICI was associated with improved median OS: 1,421 vs 667 days; HR 0.63; 95% CI 0.60-0.66; p<.001.

evidence_scatter.title: Chidamide in combination with CHOP in previously untreated peripheral T-cell lymphoma with T follicular helper phenotype: Results of the phase II SWIFT trial.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Among 35 patients who underwent post-treatment PET/CT evaluation, the best CR rate during the induction phase was 85.2% (30/35).

evidence_scatter.title: A phase II clinical study of stereotactic radiotherapy (SRT) combined with chemotherapy and tislelizumab for the treatment of metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: 24-month PFS rate in target lesions is 78%.

evidence_scatter.title: Real-world outcomes of crizotinib treatment for ALK+ and ROS1+ metastatic non-small cell lung cancer in Nepal.
Yttrium-90 SIRT plus atezolizumab/bevacizumab in unresectable huge HCC (>10 cm): A multicenter retrospective study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: The objective response rate was 61.9% (13/21), including 6 (28.6%) complete responses and 7 (33.3%) partial responses.

evidence_scatter.title: Multiplexed immunohistochemistry (mIHC) analysis and clinical outcomes of nelmastobart in combination with trifluridine/tipiracil and bevacizumab in patients with refractory colorectal cancer (phase 1b/2).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: High BTN1A1 expression was significantly associated with a higher clinical response rate.

evidence_scatter.title: Phase III CR-SEQUENCE trial of FOLFOX+panitumumab followed by FOLFIRI+bevacizumab (SEQ1) versus FOLFOX + bevacizumab followed by FOLFIRI + panitumumab (SEQ2) in previously untreated RAS wild-type, left-sided, unresectable metastatic colorectal cancer.

evidence_scatter.title: Diagnostic performance, safety, and biodistribution of [68Ga]Ga-OncoCAIX for PET/CT imaging: A first-in-human phase I clinical trial in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Promising tumour-targeting properties with concordance to histopathology; supports potential role for detection and characterisation of ccRCC.

evidence_scatter.title: Intravesical recombinant BCG combined with chemo-immunotherapy (chemo-IO) as perioperative therapy for patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC): Primary analysis of SAKK 06/19.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: 65% (26/40; one-sided 95% CI lower boundary 51%).

evidence_scatter.title: PRTH-101: An investigational treatment for thoracic solid tumors targeting discoidin domain receptor (DDR1) and the tumor microenvironment (TME).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Median progression-free survival was 5.7 months for all TEC patients and 8 months for TEC patients receiving more than one cycle. Patients with high DDR1-expressing tumors (≥25th percentile) had significantly longer PFS than patients with low-expressing tumors.

evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Confirmed objective response rate was 50% (n = 11/22).

evidence_scatter.title: Phase II randomised controlled trial on postoperative radiotherapy, in high-risk, resected, non-medullary, non-anaplastic thyroid cancers (THYRO-RT).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Locoregional recurrence occurred in 19.4% in the surgery + RAI arm and 9.7% in the Surgery+RAI+EBRT arm; arm-specific odds ratios were 1.376 (95% CI 0.852-2.222) and 0.611 (95% CI 0.299-1.632), respectively. Difference not significant (p=0.263).

evidence_scatter.title: Phase II study of adjuvant anlotinib for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma with residual disease following neoadjuvant therapy.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: No 6-month progression-free survival rate result was reported.

evidence_scatter.title: A phase Ib/II trial of first-line trastuzumab, nivolumab, gemcitabine, and cisplatin in HER2-positive biliary tract cancer (HERBOT): A multi-institutional study from the Korean Cancer Study Group.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Total ORR was 55% (95% CI: 38.5-70.7). ORR was higher with ≥10% HER2 3+ tumor cells than with <10% HER2 3+ tumor cells (80% vs 36.4%, P = 0.009). Inflamed immune phenotype ORR was 75%.

evidence_scatter.title: Real-world outcomes of trastuzumab plus chemotherapy in HER2-positive biliary tract cancers from a high-incidence region.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Median PFS 6.0 vs 1.8 months; approx. 3-fold improvement.

evidence_scatter.title: Neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy with or without PD-1 blockade in pMMR/MSS low rectal cancer patients (CHOICE II): A multi-center, open-label, randomized controlled trial.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: The cCR rates were 36.5% in the intervention group compared to 17.9% in the control group (p=0.007).

evidence_scatter.title: Phase I study of zeaxanthin alone or in combination with pembrolizumab in metastatic solid tumors.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Cohort 1 of zeaxanthin monotherapy (2 mg/kg daily) completed without DLT.

evidence_scatter.title: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy combined with toripalimab for triple-negative breast cancer: A prospective, single-arm, multi-center study (NEOTORCH-BREAST02).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: tpCR was 22/40 (55.0%; 95% CI: 38.5-70.4). Subgroup tpCR rates were 25% for CPS <1, 58.3% for CPS ≥1, 72.7% for CPS ≥10, 80% for CPS ≥20, 25% for TILs <10, 66.6% for TILs ≥10, 82.3% for TILs ≥30, 85.7% for TILs ≥50, 75% among BRCA1 mutation carriers, and 62.5% among patients with ctDNA negativity.

evidence_scatter.title: Effects of upfront dual immunotherapy on overall survival in patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with no targetable mutations or PD-L1 expression.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Patients with first-line ipilimumab plus nivolumab had superior overall survival than those treated with chemotherapy-immunotherapy [p = 0.0001].

evidence_scatter.title: Safety and efficacy of puxitatug samrotecan (Puxi-Sam, AZD8205) in patients with biliary tract cancer (BTC): A first-in-human phase 1/2a study (BLUESTAR).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: Confirmed ORR was 10.0% (95% CI: 1.2-31.7); two patients achieved partial response.

evidence_scatter.title: Brigatinib after lorlatinib and/or chemotherapy following first-line alectinib in ALK-rearranged NSCLC: Cohort B of the WJOG11919L/ABRAID study.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: ORR was 32.0% overall, 30.8% with prior lorlatinib, and 33.3% with no prior lorlatinib.

evidence_scatter.title: Clinical outcomes of enfortumab vedotin (EV) or pembrolizumab (P) interruption in metastatic urothelial carcinoma (mUC).
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: In propensity-matched analysis, interruption was associated with improved PFS (HR 0.32, 95% CI 0.25–0.70, p=0.0026).

evidence_scatter.title: Four cycles of tislelizumab plus GP regimen as neoadjuvant therapy for high-risk (T4/N3) locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
evidence_scatter.efficacy_text: 50% (12/24), achieving the predefined endpoint.
